build_fully_convolutional_model: build a FullyConvolutional PyTorch model for CIFAR-10 image classification with three convolutional blocks
create_model_with_bias: create a FullyConvolutional model instance with bias enabled in all convolutional layers
reset_model_parameters: reset the FullyConvolutional model parameters using Kaiming normal initialization for all conv layers
run_forward_pass: run a forward pass through the FullyConvolutional model on an input tensor to get class logits
review_model_architecture: review the FullyConvolutional model architecture with three blocks of conv, batch norm, and pooling layers
